physical_anchor: Produces titanium metal powder and sponge from mineral-sand ore via a hydrogen-based (HAMR) reduction process at its Titan Valley, Virginia facility; also holds a Tennessee critical-minerals project targeting rare-earth/titanium byproduct extraction.
value_chain_position: Pre-commercial titanium-metal producer (mine-to-metal), DPA Title III / DoD-funded strategic-metal build-out, not yet at nameplate revenue.
